summaries.n-post-quantum: Coins that market themselves on post-quantum cryptography and the "bunker mode" debate. On 2026-10-07 Ethereum Foundation researcher Justin Drake posted a call for the industry to "calmly begin planning for 'bunker mode'", recommending a controlled mass migration of assets to fresh addresses whose public keys stay hidden behind a hash; coverage ties the call to AI-accelerated math breaking wallet cryptography. The same day Vitalik Buterin posted that he does not recommend scrambling to move funds today but that risks to cryptography from AI-accelerated math, next to quantum, should be taken seriously, and The Block reported Europol urging the industry to prepare for quantum threats. pqc.market describes launching pump.fun coins with hash-based post-quantum attestations (WOTS one-time keys, Merkle identities); its own coin PQC and the coins QI (Quantum Inu), Tardigrade, Quantcum and BNKR (Bunker Coin) say in their metadata that they launched with its post-quantum proofs, BUNKER (Bunker Mode) describes vaults with separate hash-based authorization, and Qhost (QHOST, on Robinhood Chain) calls itself a quantum-resistant launchpad whose coins sit behind keys a quantum computer cannot break. All seven pools were created after the 2026-10-07 posts. None is shown to be affiliated with Drake, the Ethereum Foundation or Europol, and the coins' security claims are not verified. Measured: seven coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-super-intelligence: On Sept. 29 Trump said AI would officially be renamed "Super Intelligence" (Fox News). On 2026-10-04 the official @WhiteHouse account posted an announcement of a "Super Intelligence Force (SIF)", and Watcher.Guru and an @wallstreetbets post reported Elon Musk saying SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI. Super Inu ($SI), launched Sept. 21, re-pitched itself around the term; other coins followed, including another SI on pump.fun, 四 ("four", read as SI) on four.meme, Super Intelligence Force (SIF), Superintelligence Owl, two SpaceXSI coins on StonkFun, SpaceX Inu ($SI on Flap), Act II: The SI Prophecy, SuperHooks, and two newer pump.fun coins, SpaceX Super Intelligence (SPACEXSI) and My Super Intelligent Cat (Ollie), whose metadata names the term. None is shown to be affiliated with the announcements. Smaller coins named for SpaceXSI under the $100K market cap bar are not counted. Measured: fourteen coins across all their pools.

n-post-quantum.notice: Justin Drake (Ethereum Foundation researcher) posted on 2026-10-07 a call to calmly begin planning for "bunker mode" (migrating assets to addresses whose public keys stay hidden behind a hash); Vitalik Buterin posted the same day that he does not recommend scrambling to move funds today but that AI-accelerated math and quantum risks to cryptography deserve to be taken seriously; The Block reported Europol urging preparation for quantum threats. Coverage of the call was still circulating on 2026-10-09. The coins launched on pqc.market or around the debate after the posts.
n-post-quantum.interpretation: The cryptography-risk debate is real and recent, and these coins market themselves on it. The coins are not shown to be affiliated with the people or agencies quoted, their post-quantum claims are their own and unverified, and the debate itself is about possible risks, not a demonstrated break.
